# 4:5 smart crop of the talking-head edit

The 16:9 talking-head edit cut down to a 1080x1350 portrait for the Instagram and Facebook feed. smart-crop keeps a centre focal point, so Mira stays in frame; the wide caption line and the edit strip are clipped at the sides, as any 4:5 crop of a 16:9 layout would.

- Type: Smart crop
- Skill: `magnifito-variants`
- Engine: `smart-crop`
- Output: 1080x1350, 8 s, with audio
- Video: [`../videos/f08-smart-crop.mp4`](../videos/f08-smart-crop.mp4)
- Footage: synthetic, generated by the commands below. No camera footage is used.

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Use the magnifito-variants skill to make a 4:5 portrait version of the Magnifito talking-head edit (../videos/03-talking-head-edit.mp4) for the Instagram feed. Take 8 seconds from 2.5 s, smart-crop to 4:5 with a centre focus so Mira stays in frame, keep the audio, and save it as work/portrait.mp4.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- f08-smart-crop
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/f08-smart-crop/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
ffmpeg -ss 2.5 -t 8 -i ../videos/03-talking-head-edit.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/source.mp4
mgvideo smart-crop work/source.mp4 --ratio 4:5 --focus center --out work/portrait.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/portrait.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
